journey.title: My Journey
journey.description: From web development to technical leadership on product teams since 2014.

Jampp: Own features and modernization of an internal campaign management platform, from design to production
Automate operational workflows with AI agents to reduce manual work for campaign managers
Modernize legacy React code and work across frontend, backend, infrastructure, and analytics
Fix security vulnerabilities and establish maintainable engineering practices
Harness (ex Split): Built features for a feature flagging and experimentation product
Implemented reusable React hooks to simplify new feature work
Wrote technical and architecture docs to help new teammates get started
Mural: Led six engineers working on user acquisition and engagement
Redesigned the flow for sharing content and inviting users
Built feature flagging infrastructure with Optimizely for web and mobile
Integrated experiment data into Airflow pipelines
Kin + Carta (ex Solstice): Built web and mobile applications for clients with Angular, React, and Swift
Automated deployments with Travis CI and promoted TDD across teams
Built financial portals and banking applications
Built REST APIs with C# and .NET
Adistec: Built internal tools and client-facing applications
Worked on backend services and data integrations with Spring Boot and C#
